title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: A short halftime talk
hook: How long is your halftime talk, really?
intro: You have six things you want to say.
statement: Kids hold onto one or two points, not six.
q1: Do you keep halftime to one clear point —
q2: or cover everything while you have them?
q3: What do kids remember from halftime?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But second halves start better
t2: when kids carry one idea back out.
cta: Coaches — how long is your halftime talk?
ctaLines: One point. Water. A quick cheer.
ctaPrompt: Share your halftime habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How long is your halftime talk, really?
Halftime starts. You have six things you want to say.
Kids hold onto one or two points, not six.
One point or the full list. There is no perfect answer.
How long is your halftime talk? Share your habit in the comments.
